The client requires a proof of concept (POC) for validating AI/ML models and data, designed to support a centralized AI platform used by five separate business units. The scope involves evaluating existing models for vulnerabilities, developing custom validation scripts, and defining KPIs for model testing. The goal is to provide evidence that centralization and robust validation can prevent unintended biases in credit and investment decisions.

hire_title: Tax Managed Services Specialist
hire_description: Looking for a Tax Managed Services specialist to deliver comprehensive tax-related services, including tax compliance, reporting, and advisory, with a focus on efficiency and cost savings. Partnering with the client's existing tax team, you will help implement a unified approach to scale their tax capabilities while preserving institutional knowledge and business continuity.

hire_title: M&A Integration Specialist for Rapid Healthcare Acquisitions
hire_description: Need an experienced specialist to manage integration for a high-volume portfolio of 27 healthcare acquisitions completed in 15 months. The role requires supporting an Integration Management Office with daily operational surge, mapping complex billing and payroll systems, and executing due diligence across financial, HR, and clinical areas. Must ensure employee retention and service continuity while upgrading legacy infrastructure.

hire_title: ServiceNow Implementation Specialist for Medicaid Transformation
hire_description: I head a state government's IT department and need help modernizing our technology infrastructure for Medicaid services. I need an expert to implement core ServiceNow ITSM applications, automate activities, and digitize existing functions. Deliverables will include service catalog, incident reporting, problem and change management, and procedures documentation.

hire_title: Emergency response coordination and recovery planning for state disaster management
hire_description: A state government agency is preparing for and responding to a major hurricane. They need help coordinating emergency operations across multiple public and private entities. The role involves supporting the mobilization of emergency teams, first responders, and community aid groups. Tasks include gathering real-time data on storm impact and response efforts, coordinating state and local government actions, and developing operational plans for debris removal, damage assessment, and logistical support. The consultant will also assist in transitioning from response to recovery, including setting up temporary shelters and service facilities. They’ll help document recovery efforts and costs to support reimbursement from federal agencies. The work requires strong project management and coordination skills, with experience in disaster response and government operations.

hire_title: Benefits service modernization roadmap and change management consultant
hire_description:
I lead customer experience and benefits delivery for a state employment agency. During a surge in unemployment claims, applicants and staff struggled to navigate our systems and find the right assistance. I need a transformation consultant to shape a more customer-focused benefits operation and produce a practical modernization roadmap.

Work should cover:
- A detailed roadmap that sequences milestones, initiatives, and priorities for the transformation.
- Alignment of business and technical processes to standardize workflows and improve cross-program collaboration.
- A change management plan for leadership and staff, bringing user experience, customer experience, and Voice of the Customer perspectives into decisions.
- A technology approach based on publishing goals for new hardware and comparing private-market solutions rather than selecting an off-the-shelf product.

hire_title: Defense Systems Architecture Specialist
hire_description: Develop innovative approaches to architecture and integration for multi-domain systems. Characterize new technologies and systems through studies, demonstrate rapid development for fast prototyping, and leverage test and capability transitions to yield cost-effective warfighting capability.

hire_title: Sales strategy and operations for medical technology spinoff
hire_description: I lead sales operations at a medical technology company preparing for a high-growth spinoff. I need a specialist to transform our sales strategy and operational setup to support this transition. Specifically, I need an end-to-end strategy for business partner selection, moving from identifying desired partner qualities to operationalizing the onboarding process. The scope includes developing a scoring model and the necessary templates to enable rapid expansion through an indirect channel.

hire_title: Design a creative economy funding model and investor go-to-market plan
hire_description:
I run a government-funded cultural and creative fund. Our internal review showed 80% of capital idle, limited products, operating inefficiencies, minimal private co-investment, and heavy losses. I need a consultant to redesign our funding model.
- Assess the current state, estimate the national funding gap, and map value chains by sub-sector.
- Design credit, equity, and grant products, with business-line strategy, KPIs, and an annual disbursement and capital-sourcing plan.
- Build the investor go-to-market plan, set governance, review cadences, owner accountabilities, and activate early deals.

hire_title: Blockchain platform for blood supply chain tracking
hire_description: A regional blood services organization is seeking to improve visibility and traceability across its donation-to-transfusion process. A blockchain-based system is needed to track each blood unit through seven key stages: donation, testing, processing, storage, transport, transfusion, and disposal. The platform must record real-time data from IoT sensors (temperature, GPS) and integrate with existing systems. Data should be securely stored and accessible to authorized parties, with privacy protections for donor and patient information. The solution must support a proof of concept that demonstrates end-to-end traceability and auditability.

hire_title: Blockchain solution for news content verification
hire_description: We need help implementing a blockchain-based system to verify the origin and integrity of news content. The goal is to create an immutable record for each story published, including authorship, publication time, and any revisions. When a story is published, it should be automatically notarized on blockchain and assigned a verifiable icon that readers can click to see its full history. The system must integrate with our existing publishing workflow and support multiple languages. We’re looking for someone who can set up the blockchain notarization process, ensure data immutability, and design a simple verification interface for readers.
